slices.focus: Imani calls Tasha out on canceled dinners; they rebuild friendship with lighter check-ins
slices.summary: After canceling dinner with Imani twice during the complaint fallout, Tasha is gently but clearly called out. They get takeout Thai and talk honestly about the strain, leading to a reset: lower-pressure check-ins instead of elaborate dinner plans, direct honesty when Tasha is too overwhelmed, and no expectation of a full emotional debrief. The agent helps Tasha recognize this as 'friendship maintenance' rather than rescue, and Tasha plans to initiate the next plan, send a midweek check-in text, and extend a similar honest signal to one or two other important people without broadcasting widely.
open_loops: Midweek check-in text to Imani — to be sent

decisions: Imani remained a close friend, and after their conversation they were more intentional about low-pressure check-ins and
